Name: Miss Noble Caroline - English Translation
Author: januarywren
Description:
[center]﻿[/center][center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/114622928]Luoli1119[/url]﻿ was kind enough to allow me to translate her '[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10499]Miss Noble Caroline[/url]﻿' mod! The dialogue mod transforms Caroline into a compassionate, polite, and noble figure while overhauling her backstory, where she gave everything up for love. 

If you are looking for a dialogue mod that makes an NPC more interactive and welcoming, this mod is for you (Caroline will always be there to offer you a cup of tea and ask for your opinion!). :) It's perfect, too, if your Stardew Valley world has #cottagecore or fantasy vibes!

[quote][i]"Hello, [Player]. You always seem so busy...I'm afraid that you'll faint if you don't take a break! Please, let me make you a cup of tea."[/i][/quote]
[color=#b4a7d6]Mod Content[/color]

13+ recommended. *Very* light reference/s to smoking and sexual innuendo. 

[color=#ea9999]Required Mods[/color]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API
[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher [/url]﻿

[color=#d5a6bd]Mod Compatibility[/color]

This mod *is* technically compatible with other mods - however, if you use custom dialogue mods, they may override certain days depending on which mod Stardew Valley loads first. 

[color=#ea9999]Credit[/color]

Thank you to Luoli1119 for allowing me to translate their Miss Noble Caroline mod! :) And a huge thank you to Lazarus for helping me with the edits, and Dimo and Abaddon_Abyss for beta testing. 

The Portrait mod is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7443]Don's Harvest Moon-Inspired Portraits[/url]﻿. The chat box is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4697]ManaKirel's Vintage Interface V2[/url]﻿. 

[color=#b4a7d6]About Me[/color]

Hello! My name is January. I've loved writing ever since I can remember, as well as video games and modding. Modders, you guys are the best! I couldn't play Stardew Valley or Skyrim without you. Same to you, indie devs! 

If you are looking for a writer/editor for your modding projects, please send me a message! ??
